observations: Photo 0: A silver laptop with a blue Windows screen, partially wrapped in plastic, held by a hand. The screen shows a Windows login or lock screen. The laptop is in tablet mode, folded back. A watermark 'COMPUTER NIGERIA' is visible.

Photo 1: The same laptop in tent mode, showing the hinge and keyboard. The keyboard appears silver with white keys. The background shows an orange shelving unit with files and a white mug on the table.

Photo 2: The laptop in laptop mode, screen open, showing a blue Windows desktop. The keyboard and trackpad are visible. A small Intel logo is visible on the palm rest. The same orange shelving and a standing fan are in the background.
All photos show the same device from different angles. The device has a 360-degree hinge, consistent with an x360 convertible laptop.
No visible brand or model text on the device in any photo. The seller claims it is an 'HP Envy x360 7th gen'.

claims.claim: American used hp envy laptop x360 7th gen
claims.evidence: No brand or model text is visible in any photo. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the images.
Internal specs cannot be seen in photos. No system information or BIOS screen is shown.
No photo shows the keyboard illuminated. The keyboard appears to be backlit in the dark, but no active backlight is visible.
No charger is visible in any photo. The seller claims it is included, but no proof is shown.
The device appears clean in the photos, but close-up shots of the keyboard, screen edges, and ports are missing. Scratches or wear may be present but not visible.

risks.risk: The laptop may not be an HP Envy x360 7th gen as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the bottom of the laptop showing the model label, or a screenshot of the system information (e.g., Windows About page).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic convertible laptop, not as a specific HP model.

risks.risk: The SSD and RAM specs may not be as claimed (512GB SSD, 16GB RAM).
risks.proof: A screenshot of the Windows 'About' page or BIOS showing the installed storage and memory.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a lower-spec device, possibly with less RAM or smaller SSD.

risks.risk: The keyboard backlight may not work or may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the keyboard lit up in a dark room.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-backlit keyboard model.

risks.risk: The charger may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: A photo of the charger and its connector, and a video showing it plugged in and charging.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if charger is not included.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or wear on the screen, hinges, or ports.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the screen edges, hinge area, and all ports (USB, HDMI, etc.).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if there may be hidden damage, reducing value.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the bottom of the laptop showing the model label.
A screenshot of the Windows 'About' page showing the installed RAM and storage.
A photo or video of the keyboard backlight turned on.
A photo of the charger and its connector.
Close-up photos of the screen edges, hinges, and all ports.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a convertible laptop, but the brand and model cannot be confirmed from the photos. Key claims about specs, backlight, and included charger are unverified. Hidden risks like damage or incorrect specs affect pricing. Proof is needed to confirm identity and condition before pricing.
